headline: Cape Keeps Up Fire; Stonecradle and Linn Mercy Stir
war_summary: The storm at Callum's Cape has not slackened since the last edition. Two actions were logged there in the past two hours and thirty-eight across the day, the heaviest tally on the map, with four Warden works, two Colonial and one lying unclaimed; the hourly rolls run past sixteen hundred Colonial and twelve hundred Warden casualties. Mooring County remains hard behind, six actions in two hours and the latest at fourteen minutes past, its day's ledger showing near fifteen thousand Colonial and thirteen thousand seven hundred Warden dead, the Wardens holding ten works to one Colonial and one unclaimed. Linn Mercy, quiet at the last report, has stirred again — two actions in two hours, twenty-two in the day, casualties mounting sharply. Stonecradle has erupted with six actions in two hours, three of them Colonial captures. Marban Hollow's lines now read five Colonial to two Warden, a reversal from the morning. Weathered Expanse still burns, three actions this watch and one Warden work lost to the Colonial flag. Nevish Line and Godcrofts, once hot, remain silent.
